claims.text: Acute non-low-back MSK injury pain: topical NSAIDs ± menthol gel = first-line;
claims.quote: treat patients with acute pain from non-low back, musculoskeletal injuries with topical nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) with or without menthol gel as first-line therapy
claims.locator: Qaseem A, et al. Nonpharmacologic and Pharmacologic Management of Acute Pain From Non-Low Back, Musculoskeletal Injuries in Adults: A Clinical Guideline From the ACP and AAFP. Ann Intern Med 2020;173(9):739-748

claims.quote: ACP and AAFP suggest that clinicians treat patients with acute pain from non-low back, musculoskeletal injuries with oral NSAIDs to reduce or relieve symptoms
claims.locator: Qaseem A, et al. Nonpharmacologic and Pharmacologic Management of Acute Pain From Non-Low Back, Musculoskeletal Injuries in Adults: A Clinical Guideline From the ACP and AAFP. Ann Intern Med 2020;173(9):739-748
